title: What is a click worth? The auction and the numbers

say: What is a click worth? The auction and the numbers.
This is the video for module 1 of Paid Advertising with Google Ads.
Most adverts interrupt people. A search ad shows only after someone has typed what they want into Google.
When a person in Ibadan types inverter installation near me, she is telling you her need, her place and often her hurry. That is called search intent.

say: Google gives each keyword a Quality Score from 1 to 10. Think of it as a warning light. It has three parts.
First, expected click-through rate, or CTR: how likely your ad is to be clicked.

panel.heading: The three parts of Quality Score

cards.d: How likely your ad is to be clicked. Put the searcher's words and a clear offer in the headline.
How closely the ad matches the search. Split keywords into tight themes, one need per ad.
How useful the page is after the click. Send people to the matching page, fast on mobile.

say: Second, ad relevance. If this is low, the keyword probably sits in the wrong ad group.

panel.heading: The three parts of Quality Score

cards.d: How likely your ad is to be clicked. Put the searcher's words and a clear offer in the headline.
How closely the ad matches the search. Split keywords into tight themes, one need per ad.
How useful the page is after the click. Send people to the matching page, fast on mobile.

say: Third, landing page experience. If this is below average, cleverer ads will not fix it. Fix the page.
In the course example, Installer A bids 300 naira with good quality, takes the top spot and pays about 251 naira a click, while Installer B bids 500 naira and sits lower.

panel.rule: Know what a customer is worth before you set any bid.

say: Here is Tunde, who installs home solar systems in Ibadan. These figures are illustrative, so always use your client's own numbers.

card.title: Tunde, a solar installer in Ibadan

say: His average job is about 1,200,000 naira. His margin is 25%, so gross profit per job is 300,000 naira.

card.title: Tunde, a solar installer in Ibadan

say: From his records, 1 in 10 enquiries becomes a paid job. That is a 10% close rate, so each lead is worth 30,000 naira.

card.title: Tunde, a solar installer in Ibadan

say: He is willing to spend one third of that on ads, so his target cost per lead is 10,000 naira.

card.title: Tunde, a solar installer in Ibadan

say: His service page turns about 5% of visitors into enquiries. So his maximum CPC is 500 naira.
If Keyword Planner shows most of his keywords well below that, the market is workable.

card.title: Tunde, a solar installer in Ibadan

say: Keyword Planner is a free tool inside Google Ads. Set the location to the area the business serves, and look at the bid ranges.
If the high-range bids sit below your maximum CPC, go ahead. Start with buying words like price, near me or install.

Words like price, near me, install
right: Bids well above your max CPC

say: If bids are well above your maximum CPC, you will lose money on most clicks. Improve the conversion rate or close rate first, or target narrower, cheaper terms.

say: This is your client's money, so protect it. Divide the monthly budget by 30.4 to get the daily budget. For Tunde, 300,000 naira a month becomes about 9,900 naira a day.
A busy day can spend up to 2 times that, but the month stays capped. Tell the client before launch, so a busy day does not cause panic.
And recheck bid ranges before every proposal.

say: To remember. Search ads reach people who already said what they want, and good quality can win a better spot for less.
Lead value is gross profit times close rate. Maximum CPC is target cost per lead times conversion rate.
When the numbers are tight, raise the conversion rate or close rate.
